benefits.description: Up to $100 Annual Hotel Benefit ($500+ stay through Citi Travel)
benefits.notes: Once per calendar year, receive $100 off a single hotel stay of $500 or more, excluding taxes and fees, booked through Citi Travel. The discount is applied at booking.

reviewNotes: Trackable-benefit scope intentionally excludes the welcome offer, earning multipliers, transfer partners, travel protections, and other always-on card features. Catalog synchronization disposition: the new immutable card and benefit keys should plan as creates in a later separately authorized sync; no database sync is part of this contribution. Existing-card propagation disposition: after that authorized sync, normal insert-only materialization should add the missing current benefit status to linked active physical cards without rewriting user state. Benefit Usage Guide disposition: link this benefit to the existing citi-travel-hotel-benefit guide. Prior-status disposition: there are no prior statuses for this genuinely new catalog identity; preserve any unrelated legacy or custom rows for separate adoption review.
